payload.reason: The evidence specifies the datasets used for training and evaluation in the experiments.

claims.text: The primary corpus used is the Japanese-English (Ja-En) ASPEC dataset.
A subset of 500K sentence pairs from the ASPEC dataset is selected for training the models.
The WMT dataset for English-German (En-De) is also used, specifically news-test2014, news-test2015, and news-test2016.
